# RadioMaster

> RadioMaster is free, open-source (MIT) radio automation software for Windows, macOS and Linux, made by DovaFM Digital Entertainment Group. It runs a radio station from one screen: playlist tabs with live start times, hour markers, smart crossfades, advert and jingle scheduling, a playlist generator, an event scheduler, a cart wall, microphone ducking, voice tracking, text to speech, Icecast/Shoutcast streaming (MP3, AAC, Opus, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC) and AzuraCast station management. RadioMaster Server is a headless version for Linux and Windows Server that the desktop app controls with File → Connect to Server.

RadioMaster is an independent project and is not affiliated with RadioBOSS, SAM Broadcaster, ZaraRadio or AzuraCast. There is no account, subscription or paid edition.

## Pages

- [RadioMaster home](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/): features, screenshots, downloads and FAQ
- [RadioMaster Server](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/server/): headless radio automation for Linux and Windows Server, setup and connecting from the desktop app
- [How to start an internet radio station for free](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/guides/start-an-internet-radio-station/): step-by-step guide
- [Updates](https://radiomaster.dovafm.com/updates/): release notes for every version
